visual.altText: Imani stands beside the greenhouse work table with the yellow seed packet. Pip, a small white wheeled robot with a blue front light, waits beside her. Red terrain is visible through a sealed window.
Imani kneels beside Pip at the greenhouse work table. Pip has one open side panel with a visibly loose cable. A tool shelf and rear rows of plants remain in the established greenhouse.
At the work table, Imani rests her hand near Pip, which now carries the yellow seed packet. The open cable panel and distant rear planting table are visible; tools stay on the shelf.
At the rear planting table, Imani plants seeds while Pip steadies the opened yellow packet. Pip's side panel is now closed. Soft greenhouse lights illuminate the plants and natural human proportions.
At the rear planting table, Imani opens the yellow packet while Pip waits with its blue light on. Its side panel is still open; do not show repaired cables or imply speech in this route.
